name: Toe Touches
steps: Lie on your back and raise your legs toward the ceiling, knees soft.
Reach both arms up toward your feet.
Breathe out and curl your shoulders up to reach toward your toes.
Lower your shoulders slowly, keeping the legs still.
cues: Reach with the chest, not the chin

common_mistakes.mistake: Legs drifting down toward the floor
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the feet over the hips; bend knees if needed
Keep a fist of space under the chin

common_mistakes.mistake: Swinging the arms to get up
common_mistakes.fix: Lift by curling the stomach, arms just follow
